hints.buttons: Use Button for every action. Destructive only for actions that cannot be undone.
hints.fields: Label + Input or Textarea. A field's validation error stays below it, in red.
hints.selects: In forms use NativeSelect (it submits with the form and works on phones). Select is for rich lists outside forms.
hints.choices: Checkbox for yes/no inside a form, Switch to turn something on or off at once, RadioGroup for one choice among a few options.
hints.tabs: To split a screen into parts of the same subject.
hints.badges: For status and category, never as a button.
hints.cards: To group a block of content with a title.
hints.alerts: Only for page states (expired link, access denied). Action results go to the notice banner (ADR 0016).
hints.accordion: Items that open to show details. Use variant="cards" on new screens; the default lines are for simple lists.
hints.items: shadcn Item with variant="card" for lists of files and records; FieldCard for a read-only value with an action (copy, open).
hints.inputGroup: A field with buttons next to the text, like the AI message box. Not for regular forms.
hints.empty: When a list or tab has nothing yet. Say what to do next.
hints.stats: Framed StatCard for the main numbers; StatGroup for several numbers side by side inside a card; Amount greys the cents (optional).
hints.keyValue: Short label and value summaries, such as rates and times.
hints.tags: Filters and audiences the person can remove. Show a few and count the rest.
hints.headers: Every new screen starts with PageCanvas (grey background) and PageTitle; each block has a SectionHeader with actions on the right.
